comment: cmd.c dotherecmdmenu() and doclicklook() witness. A debug-mode Valkyrie polymorphs into a dwarf, so the here-menu offers 'Look at map symbol' (there_cmd_menu_common() requires Upolyd for the hero's own spot). #therecmdmenu answered with the simulated-mouse key '_' and '.' on the hero opens here_cmd_menu(); 'g' sets clicklook_cc to the hero's spot and queues #clicklook, which describes the dwarf. A second #therecmdmenu finds clicklook_cc on the hero and calls here_cmd_menu() directly (cmd.c:4353-4354); picking 'g' again queues #clicklook, but dotherecmdmenu() then resets clicklook_cc to -1,-1 (4357), so doclicklook() returns at its isok() test (5383-5384) and prints nothing.
